Job Description:
 Job Summary**
Responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining NC programs for complex aerospace components, ensuring efficient and high-quality manufacturing processes.
Job Responsibilities**
 Develop NC programs for multi-axis machining centers (e.g., 3-axis, 5-axis, mill-turn) using CATIA V5, DELMIA, or similar CAM software.
 Analyze engineering drawings, 3D models, and specifications to determine optimal machining strategies and tooling requirements.
 Simulate and verify NC programs to detect potential collisions, ensure material removal, and optimize cycle times.
 Collaborate with design engineers, manufacturing engineers, and production teams to resolve technical issues and improve manufacturability.
 Select appropriate cutting tools, fixtures, and work holding devices based on material properties and machining requirements.
 Optimize existing NC programs for efficiency, reduced cycle time, and improved surface finish.
 Perform post-processing and create setup sheets, tool lists, and other necessary documentation for machine operators.
 Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to NC programming processes and technologies.
 Troubleshoot and debug NC programs on the shop floor as needed.
 Adhere to all safety regulations and quality standards.
 Job Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.
 Proven experience as an NC Programmer, preferably within the aerospace industry.
 Proficiency in CAM software, particularly CATIA V5.
 Strong understanding of G-code and M-code programming.
 In-depth knowledge of various machining processes (milling, turning, drilling, etc.) and assembly process (drilling, riveting, etc) and materials common in aerospace (e.g., aluminum alloys, titanium, composites).
 Ability to interpret complex engineering drawings 3D models.
 Experience with machine tool simulation and verification software.
 Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
 Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
 Fluency in English (written and spoken).
 Travel & Training (Mandatory): Flexibility for travel to Germany is strictly required. The role demands a minimum estimated training time of approximately 1.5 years (80%) at the German plant.
This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
